metadata.description: ZCode 输入框下方状态条：生成速度色阶、累计 token、缓存命中、子代理状态与官方上下文圆环增强

plugins.name: zcode-statusbar
plugins.description: ZCode composer status bar: visual tok/s speed ramp, cumulative tokens, cache hit and subagent state under the input box, plus a color-ramp enhancement for the official context ring. Auto-installs via app.asar injection (fully quit and reopen ZCode to take effect). No per-answer text lines, no prompt-submit context injection, no cost/quota features; no network except the Release updater.
